description: Bolt inventory plugin: lists NodeRings virtual machines as Bolt targets. Use it from inventory.yaml with _plugin: noderings.

token.description: NodeRings API token. Defaults to the NODERINGS_TOKEN environment variable on the Bolt controller.

organization_id.description: Organization to list VMs from. Defaults to the token's organization.

tags.description: Only VMs that have every one of these tags.

power_states.description: Only VMs in these power states, such as running or stopped. Use [all] for every VM. Defaults to [running].

name_pattern.description: Only VMs whose hostname matches this regular expression.

target_mapping.description: Where each target field comes from: name, uri, alias, features take a VM field name; config, facts and vars take a hash of field names. Defaults to name: hostname, uri: ipv4.
